en.headline: New World shareholders criticise rights issue at annual general meeting
en.dek: Hundreds of investors queued outside the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre to question the HK$24.9 billion plan that would dilute their holdings unless they subscribe.
body: Shareholders of New World Development voiced strong criticism of the company's proposed HK$24.9 billion rights issue on the sidelines of its annual general meeting at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on Thursday.

Hundreds of shareholders lined up before the meeting to demand answers over the 11-for-1 offer priced at 90 cents per share, an 81.5 per cent discount to the last closing price before the announcement. Minority investors face either paying substantial sums to maintain their stakes or seeing their ownership diluted sharply.

Some shareholders said they planned to wait and monitor the share price before deciding, while others indicated they would use savings to take up the rights. Executives, including chief executive Echo Huang, described the issue as an active restructuring to protect assets rather than a reactive measure, and said liquidity would be constrained if the plan failed.

The controlling Cheng family, through Chow Tai Fook Enterprises, has committed to take up its full entitlement and underwrite the remainder. The proposal requires approval from independent shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting in January. New World shares have fallen sharply since the plan was announced on Sunday.

zh.headline: 新世界發展股東在股東周年大會批評供股計劃
zh.dek: 數百名投資者在會展中心外排隊，質疑249億元供股若不全數認購將大幅攤薄持股。
body: 新世界發展股東周四在香港會議展覽中心舉行的股東周年大會場外，強烈批評公司建議的249億元供股計劃。
數百名股東在會議前排隊要求交代，供股以11供1、每股0.9元發行，較宣布前收市價折讓81.5%。小股東若要維持持股比例需投入大筆資金，否則持股將大幅攤薄。
部分股東表示會先觀察股價再決定，另有人計劃動用積蓄認購。行政總裁黃紹美等管理層指，供股是主動重組以保護資產，而非被動措施，若計劃失敗流動性將受限制。
控股的鄭氏家族透過周大福企業已承諾全數認購本身配額並包銷餘下股份。計劃須待一月特別股東大會由獨立股東批准。新世界股份自周日宣布計劃後已大幅下跌。
